title: Add "Hide minimized window content" sub-option to "Highlight windows when hovering over tasks"
line: The Task Manager can now show minimized windows as a dark silhouette instead of their contents when you hover over their previews.
explanation: With "Hide other windows when hovering over previews" on, KWin's highlight effect fades minimized windows in with their full contents, so hovering a task reveals whatever a minimized window shows. There was no way to keep the position-and-size hint without the contents. KWin's highlight effect gains a D-Bus overload highlightWindows(windows, hideMinimizedContent) that paints minimized windows at zero brightness and half opacity, and the Task Manager gets an indented sub-option "Hide contents of minimized windows" that passes it.

commits.message:
plugins/highlightwindow: allow hiding the contents of minimized windows

Highlighting a minimized window always showed its full contents, so a
task manager hover could reveal what a hidden window has on screen. A
new D-Bus overload draws minimized windows as a dark silhouette instead.

BUG: 418020

applets/taskmanager: add option to hide contents of minimized windows

Hovering a task with window highlighting on showed the full contents of
minimized windows, which some people would rather keep private. A new
sub-option asks KWin to show only their position and size instead.

BUG: 418020

patches.diff:
From 73380adbe635921e437928ce8f6e1ce8fc47651f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:09:02 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: add option to hide contents of minimized
 windows

Hovering a task with window highlighting on showed the full contents of
minimized windows, which some people would rather keep private. A new
sub-option asks KWin to show only their position and size instead.

BUG: 418020
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml                 | 4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml | 9 +++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml             | 2 +-
 3 files changed, 14 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..68640f3834 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -102,6 +102,10 @@
       <label>Whether to request the window manager highlight windows when hovering corresponding task tooltips.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="hideMinimizedWindowContents" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether highlighted minimized windows are shown without their contents.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="launchers" type="StringList">
       <label>The list of launcher tasks on the widget. Usually .desktop file or executable URLs. Special URLs such as preferred://browser that expand to default applications are supported.</label>
       <default>applications:systemsettings.desktop,applications:org.kde.discover.desktop,preferred://filemanager,preferred://browser</default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 6f19a68e96..27c7597553 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
 
     property alias cfg_showToolTips: showToolTips.checked
     property alias cfg_highlightWindows: highlightWindows.checked
+    property alias cfg_hideMinimizedWindowContents: hideMinimizedWindowContents.checked
     property bool cfg_indicateAudioStreams
     property bool cfg_interactiveMute
     property bool cfg_tooltipControls
@@ -55,6 +56,14 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             text: showToolTips.checked ? i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide other windows when hovering over previews") : i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide other windows when hovering over tooltips")
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: hideMinimizedWindowContents
+            leftPadding: mirrored ? 0 : (highlightWindows.indicator.width + highlightWindows.spacing)
+            rightPadding: mirrored ? (highlightWindows.indicator.width + highlightWindows.spacing) : 0
+            text: i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide contents of minimized windows")
+            enabled: highlightWindows.checked
+        }
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: indicateAudioStreams
             text: i18nc("@option:check section General", "Show an indicator when a task is playing audio")
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..b0b1124a9d 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -109,7 +109,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         }
         hoveredWinIds = winIds
 
-        return DBus.SessionBus.asyncCall({service: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", path: "/org/kde/KWin/HighlightWindow", iface: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", member: "highlightWindows", arguments: [hovered ? winIds : []], signature: "(as)"});
+        return DBus.SessionBus.asyncCall({service: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", path: "/org/kde/KWin/HighlightWindow", iface: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", member: "highlightWindows", arguments: [hovered ? winIds : [], Plasmoid.configuration.hideMinimizedWindowContents], signature: "(asb)"});
     }
 
     function cancelHighlightWindows(): DBus.DBusPendingReply {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Hovering the preview of a minimized Konsole: its whole contents (the "private" line) are shown on the desktop.
Same hover with the new option on: the minimized window shows as a dark silhouette with its position and size, no contents.
The new sub-option under "Hide other windows when hovering over previews" (disabled when that is off).
Hover in and out: the silhouette fades in and out, the contents never flash.
